test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in the correct order.

The economic slowdown

P. reducing consumer spending

Q. in multiple industries

R. straining household incomes and

S. has led to job losses
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence describes the effects of an economic slowdown and how it has impacted various aspects of the economy.
 
• The correct order of the sentence should logically follow the sequence of cause and effect.
 
• The correct arrangement is **SQRP**, as this sequence explains the economic slowdown leading to job losses, which strained household incomes, further reducing consumer spending in multiple industries.
 
• Option 2 is the correct answer as it provides a coherent and meaningful arrangement.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The economic slowdown has led to job losses, straining household incomes and reducing consumer spending in multiple industries."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **S: "has led to job losses,"** – This part introduces the primary consequence of the economic slowdown.
 
• **O: "straining household incomes and"** – This part explains the further impact caused by job losses.
 
• **R: "reducing consumer spending"** – This part highlights the effect on consumer behavior due to strained incomes.
 
• **P: "in multiple industries."** – This part specifies the industries affected by reduced consumer spending.
